Parameter magnitudes chosen so diffusion, Michaelis adsorption, and cooperative desorption are all comparable and active: k_ads=20/K_half=50 gives an adsorption sink of order 10 vs diffusion ~C/2; k_des=10/K_des=20 activates desorption once S_ads grows; S_max=50 lets theta_occ reach ~0.3-0.5; tau_des=tau_theta=5 keep the auxiliary states responsive within the window. Substitution check finite/real at a representative point.
